slides.title: AU–EU security retreat opens in Addis Ababa
Who is meeting
slides.body: The African Union Peace and Security Council and the EU Political and Security Committee.

slides.title: Four priorities
slides.body: Maritime security, counter-terrorism, AI governance, and women, peace and security.

slides.title: No outcomes reported yet
slides.body: Capital FM reports no decisions on Ethiopia or the Horn of Africa. Single outlet.

slides.title: Dialogue that protects civilians
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
